roles.TRAIN_GEOMETRY: all fits, tuning and pseudo-target outcomes

representation: exact final affine classifier input in frozen canonical model
primary_partition: PROTECTED versus its full raw-embedding orthogonal complement
source_selector: exact existing PEEH cap-32-per-subject-session-class persistence spectrum, 200 subject-permutation nulls, five subject-half utility splits, 100 equal-rank random erasures, 20000 biological-subject bootstrap draws; no change to selection definition
nested_geometry: two deterministic biological-subject cross-fit halves; each pseudo-target is scored using a P/C basis fitted and source-only selected on the opposite half; final OUTER basis is fitted on all TRAIN_GEOMETRY subjects
source_statistics: all TRAIN_GEOMETRY source-session embeddings except the pseudo-target subject in inner episodes; all TRAIN_GEOMETRY source-session embeddings on OUTER
target_context: unlabeled source-session embeddings from pseudo-target or OUTER subject; deterministic first B complete context units in cache order; evaluation on future session of that same subject
erp_context_unit: one complete contiguous 12-stimulus sequence in a subject/session cache, validated to contain exactly two target codes; incomplete or malformed sequences are excluded from context only and disclosed, not from outcome evaluation
source_only_lambda_and_budget_selection: maximize biological-subject-equal future-session BA of the best homogeneous alpha, across TRAIN pseudo-target episodes; ties: lower NLL, then smaller context budget, smaller lambda, smaller alpha
source_only_partition_alpha_selection: for fixed selected lambda and budget, maximize biological-subject-equal future-session BA; ties: lower NLL, then smaller total update norm, then lexicographic alpha_P and alpha_C; select best off-diagonal separately from best homogeneous
normmatch: sqrt of TRAIN pseudo-target mean squared differential update norm divided by mean squared generic update norm, clipped to [0,1]
paired_bootstrap_unit: unique biological subject after averaging repeated fold appearances
operator: diagonal target-unlabeled affine representation recalibration with shrinkage toward source statistics
decision_gate: attachment version 1, all five gates A-E and interpretation cases A-E; no post-OUTER changes
